policy.live_sources: all publishable .md and .markdown outside historical subtrees
policy.preserved_md_txt: not live Markdown; still checked when linked as a destination
policy.local_destinations: exact-case publication file or directory; repository escape rejected
policy.fragments: GitHub-style ATX/Setext heading slugs, duplicate suffixes, explicit id/name anchors; source line ranges when applicable
policy.external_destinations: unchecked; no HTTP, DNS, authentication, or release-asset validation
policy.execution_scope: documentation inspection only; no examples, tests, studies, or proof builds
